title: Mitigating Geospatial Knowledge Hallucination in Large Language Models: Benchmarking and Dynamic Factuality Aligning

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM hallucination rates and factual accuracy on geospatial knowledge multiple-choice questions (using the GEOHALUBENCH benchmark) between highly represented major cities (e.g., New York, London, Beijing) and underrepresented regions (e.g., Cairo, Kabul, Sucre).
